materials.name: Observatory interior · 天文台室内
materials.prompt: Create original wide 16:9 background art for a 2D indie point-and-click mystery, a locked mountaintop observatory, 1890s. A carefully composed atmospheric hand-painted storybook gouache illustration, sharp confident shapes, cinematic soft light and subtle paper grain, jewel dark teal and warm honey brass palette, a believable beautiful inviting room. Full-frame landscape architecture viewed from inside at night. Three spatially SEPARATE, easily visible game props 1) open illuminated astronomical logbook atop a broad wooden desk in the LOWER LEFT quarter, its book centered 22% across 72% down, 2) magnificent large brass telescope with tripod CENTER of the room, shaft centered 53% across 48% down, 3) a vintage signal transmitter console with a red telegraph lever and small glowing amber bulbs on a pedestal on the RIGHT, centered 83% across 63% down. Behind the telescope a grand circular dome window with shadowed struts, crescent moon, luminous stars and misty mountains below. The observatory's high dark ribbed dome occupies upper part of composition, charming shelves on side walls, uncluttered near scenery. Balanced midtones for readability. No text, letters, numbers, labels, typography, watermark, callouts, user interface, border, people, decorative Celtic knots or insignia. All three props fully within frame. Highest craft of indie point and click adventure environment concept art. Landscape 16:9, one frame only.

materials.name: A note in the margin · 页边手记
materials.data:
03:17 · Cygnus, 42° NE
If three notes return, the ship has made it home.

03:17 · 天鹅座，东北 42°
若听见三个回音，说明飞船已平安归来。

materials.name: Three returning notes · 三声回音
Field note from the tide keeper
materials.data: The brass dial points home at the third bell.

feedback.en: A mark in the margin points to Cygnus. You copy the coordinates onto your sleeve.
feedback.zh: 页边的记号指向天鹅座。你把坐标抄在衣袖上。

feedback.en: Three flashes answer from beyond the ridge. The missing ship is safe.
feedback.zh: 山脊后闪起三道回应的光。失踪的飞船平安无事。

blocked.en: The sky is too wide to search. Where did the last astronomer record her bearings?
blocked.zh: 星空太大了。上一位天文学家把方位记在哪儿了？

blocked.en: The rescue tower needs a confirmed sighting. Check the telescope first.
blocked.zh: 救援塔需要确切的目击信息，先去望远镜看看。

blocked.en: You need to see who is calling before you answer privately.
blocked.zh: 你得先确认是谁在呼叫，才能私下回信。

text.en: Your broadcast brings every rescue lamp on the ridge to life. By sunrise, the missing crew is walking home.
text.zh: 广播响彻山谷，山脊上的救援灯依次亮起。日出时分，失踪的船员终于踏上归途。

text.en: You return the three notes on the private channel. A silver wing tips in farewell. The sky keeps its secret.
text.zh: 你在私人频道回送三个音符。银色机翼轻轻倾斜，向你道别。星空守住了它的秘密。

intro.en: A film strip is tucked into the star ledger. Read it, align the telescope and decide who should hear your reply.
intro.zh: 星图册里夹着一段短片。读懂提示，校准望远镜，再决定把回信发给谁。
